reason: I only take gummies or drinks, and this is 2 capsules every evening. My doctor said my magnesium might be low, so I care, but I would not stick with pills.
objection: It is capsules, and I hate swallowing pills. Also, why just one form of magnesium when other brands put 8 forms in one capsule?
would_change_my_mind: A gummy or drink version with the same lab-tested dose, or a clear reason why bisglycinate alone is enough for low magnesium.
